title: Nexus UpdateCharacterBindingRequest
description: Request body for PATCH /v1/daemon/characters/:character_id/bindings/:binding_id. Only world_sheet_entry_id is mutable; null unlinks, omission keeps.

world_sheet_entry_id.description: Optional WorldSheet KnowledgeEntry id (kb_, at most 128 bytes). Null unlinks; omission keeps the current link.
